setup_mechanisms.Trend Continuation: Institutional re-add at the rising EMA21/EMA50 pullback · trend uninterrupted · low-stress entry.
setup_mechanisms.Breakout Expansion: Supply absorbed during the base · the lid breaks · momentum continues until volume fades.
setup_mechanisms.VCP Breakout: Volatility Contraction Pattern · tightening price action precedes expansion · classic Minervini setup.
setup_mechanisms.Near-VCP Breakout: Pre-VCP — base forming but pivot not yet broken · early-entry on tightening volume.
setup_mechanisms.52wk Breakout: Price clears 52-week high on volume · attention vacuum + breakout-buyer demand drives continuation.
setup_mechanisms.Stage 2 Breakout (52w high): Stage 2 trend with 52w high break · institutional uptrend confirmation.
setup_mechanisms.EMA21 Pullback: Trend pulls back to rising 21EMA · institutional re-add at moving-average support.
setup_mechanisms.EMA50 Pullback: Trend pulls back to rising 50EMA · deeper institutional re-add point.
setup_mechanisms.Squeeze Breakout: Bollinger Band squeeze releases · volatility-compression breakout · expanding range.
setup_mechanisms.Squeeze Expansion: Post-squeeze expansion · momentum follows the compression release.
setup_mechanisms.Pocket Pivot: O'Neil pocket pivot · volume cluster above 10-day price during base · institutional accumulation.
setup_mechanisms.Bounce off Support: Mean-reversion off prior support · oversold reading + reclaim.
setup_mechanisms.Impulse Catalyst: News-driven gap on attention vacuum · post-event drift in direction of surprise (PEAD).
setup_mechanisms.Special Situation: Forced supply imbalance — short squeeze, float rotation, or insider cluster · asymmetric upside.
setup_mechanisms.Breakdown: Trend break to the downside · short setup · breakdown-seller demand drives continuation.
setup_mechanisms.Insider Cluster: ≥3 insider buys within 30 days · informed-buyer signal · alpha-bearing event.
setup_mechanisms.RS New High: Relative-strength line makes a new high before price · leadership reveal.
setup_mechanisms.10-Week Pullback: Pullback to the 10-week (50d) moving average within a Stage 2 trend.

setup_falsifications.Trend Continuation: Close below the 21EMA on volume — institutions stop defending the pullback.
setup_falsifications.Breakout Expansion: Close back inside the base on volume — failed breakout, supply re-emerges.
setup_falsifications.VCP Breakout: Volume breakout fails to hold above pivot for 2 closes — no follow-through demand.
setup_falsifications.Near-VCP Breakout: Pivot fails on first attempt with high volume — base is wider than tradeable.
setup_falsifications.52wk Breakout: Daily close back below the 52w high pivot on volume — breakout failure / bull trap.
setup_falsifications.Stage 2 Breakout (52w high): Two consecutive closes below the 50-day moving average — stage 2 broken.
setup_falsifications.EMA21 Pullback: Daily close below the 21EMA AND below the prior swing low.
setup_falsifications.EMA50 Pullback: Daily close below the 50EMA AND below the prior swing low.
setup_falsifications.Squeeze Breakout: Bands re-contract within 5 days of the breakout — failed expansion.
setup_falsifications.Squeeze Expansion: Price re-enters the squeeze range on falling volume.
setup_falsifications.Pocket Pivot: Volume fails to follow through in the next 3 sessions — no institutional support.
setup_falsifications.Bounce off Support: Support breaks on close with above-average volume — no buying demand.
setup_falsifications.Impulse Catalyst: Gap fills within 3 days OR catalyst is denied/walked back officially.
setup_falsifications.Special Situation: Catalyst is denied, hedge unwound, or float-rotation reverses on volume.
setup_falsifications.Breakdown: Close back above prior support level — failed breakdown, short squeeze risk.
setup_falsifications.Insider Cluster: Follow-on insider sells within 14 days — cluster invalidated.
setup_falsifications.RS New High: RS-line rolls over within 5 days while price still rising — divergence.
setup_falsifications.10-Week Pullback: Close below the 10-week moving average on volume.
